rule: Use exact versions initially, compile adapters, then commit Cargo.lock. This is a forward-looking dependency baseline; only APIs listed in docs/dependency-adapters.md have been compiled and checked.
notes: OpenMLS 0.9.2 is the selected RFC 9420 implementation; group provider, persistence and API integration still require T02/T31 compilation probes.
T06 compiled k256 0.14.0, rand 0.10.4 and sha3 0.12.0 for secp256k1 root identity, fallible OS randomness and Keccak signatures. This does not verify public-chain proofs.
Windows DPAPI functions are implemented and exercised by local-user round-trip/corruption tests; other Windows accounts and machine migration are not covered.
eframe/egui 0.35.0 replaced 0.37.0 after Cargo proved a js-sys links conflict with libp2p 0.57.1's wasm dependency; the selected version remains within the supported Rust 1.95 baseline.
egui/eframe report MSRV 1.95; the selected toolchain is newer.
cap-std is not a replacement for the Windows platform security implementation.
unicode-normalization includes a Unicode-3.0 license component; preserve dependency notices.
rmcp uses Apache-2.0; the ASL project's own MIT license does not replace third-party licenses.
Extra build/test utilities require their own locked versions and license review during T01.
